task.claim:
CP6-782 G1 (D = -339): for alpha = 1 + 4*omega (N(alpha) = 1365) with the
`int` digit set, the element z = -2 + 2*omega has digit 680 and
T(z) = (z - 680)/alpha = z, so its expansion never terminates. ("The 10 int
rules for elements with |b| >= 2 (... 1+4w on CP6-782) do not: a cycle is
found in the disk.")
